newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 84-day T-bills yield 9.050 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 84-day T-bills yield 9.050 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 84-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 9.050 percent versus 8.824 percent for the NZ$75 million of a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The average yield for NZ$75 million of 182-day bills was 8.624 percent versus 8.395 percent for the $75 million of similar treasury bills at the last tender.
The average yield for $50 million of 399-day bills was 8.005 percent versus 8.019 percent for the $50 million of similar treasury bills tendered last week.
